variables: Even velocity-density and odd-current perturbations have energy z_even^T H z_even+z_odd^T z_odd, H=I+b b^T. D contains q*v in thermal units. Gibbs whitening gives the symmetric positive oscillator B=H^(1/2) D^2 H^(1/2).
spectrum: If B=U diag(lambda) U^T, the electron-density spectral weights are |U^T H^(-1/2) e|^2. They are nonnegative. Their sum is e^T H^(-1)e=1-kappa_e^2/(q^2+sum kappa_s^2); their frequency-squared moment is e^T D^2 e=q^2*kT/m_e, with the corresponding quadrature moments before the continuum limit.
coupling: Exact cell overlap integrates each spectral atom. Symmetric detailed-balance flux uses d/[2sinh(d/2)] and the geometric LTE susceptibility; the existing positive angular/recoil assembly conserves finite energy and number.
limit: Conditional collisionless Maxwell/RPA and finite photon-cell model; not an atomic or full nonideal quantum certificate.
